bio.text: Mae Flexer was sworn in to the Connecticut State Senate in January 2015 to represent the 29th District.
From 2008 to 2014 she served three terms in the Connecticut House of Representatives for the 44th Assembly District, which covers Killingly and Plainfield.
She is a graduate of Killingly High School and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Connecticut.
The page also says she works as executive director of Emerge Connecticut.
